verdict.rationale: Jan documents a built-in OpenAI-compatible local API server (localhost:1337) intended as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs, which AI-native users/agents can call to drive the product programmatically, and it also supports MCP for agentic tool use. However, there is no discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt (probes return 404s), so the API's documentation is informal/README-level rather than a rigorously specified public API reference. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/swagger schema, llms.txt or machine-readable API reference, independent confirmation of API robustness.
